name: Team Proposal
description: Word doc proposing the team shape + estimate for an engagement. Engine fills cover, totals, and the per-role table; AI writes one engagement-context narrative explaining why this team shape was chosen given the findings + risks.

sections.title: Engagement context narrative
sections.purpose: 3–4 sentences explaining the proposed team rationale for THIS engagement. Reference the dominant findings/risks/recommendations that drove the role mix and seniority shape (e.g. 'an emphasis on identity work pushed two senior security architects' or 'the lack of platform engineering capability requires a hands-on tech lead'). Avoid listing per-role specifics — the table below does that. Prose only.
